message: Vector Rebel 3.2.88: Enterprise-only slow read-only PPE worker bridge and BC date query correction.
releaseNotes: The Enterprise slow worker broker coordinates one read-only browser source task at a time, with a nine-minute minimum between PPE passes and two small staffing refresh windows per Central operational day. A dedicated, authenticated Vector tab marked mvci_worker=ppe may use only one C-shift Responsible Party native Item Log read per rotation, with round-robin fairness and one-owner gear mapping on demand. Captain inspection on a different tab remains human-led, and an active Captain or official check blocks background navigation. A dedicated CrewSense tab with Rebel Scout 1.1.53 and mvci_worker=staffing captures only the current operational-day ListView full census. Other workstations remain unaffected and need no background setup. This build also corrects BC department-wide roster query to forward the selected date. Neither client submits any official inspection or edits CrewSense. Source reads require existing authenticated signed-in sessions, and no source completion is invented. Worker coordinator is installed on Enterprise separately and reports OFFLINE if either authenticated tab is not connected. Background PPE source currently scopes the proven C-shift pilot; wider department PPE collection remains a separate acceptance item.
